title: Windows artefact triage names of batch p2-G12-3 (windows_artifact_triage, P367)

attributes.windows_artifact: Windows artefact triage facts (P367): {format (lnk|onenote|onetoc2|msi|msp|mst), status, reason, parser (LnkParse3/olefile/pymsi or the built-in reader), detected_by (magic|extension), markers, warnings, partial}; parsed offline, nothing executed
attributes.windows_artifact_summary: one summary line per Windows artefact (LNK target and markers, OneNote embedded files, MSI product and custom actions)
attributes.lnk_shortcut: Windows shortcut (LNK) facts: {target, target_sources (environment block, LinkInfo, ID list, relative path), arguments, working_dir, icon_location, icon_index, description, show_command, link_flags, file_attributes, target_times, target_size, drive_type, volume_label, network_share, droid, extra_blocks, string_data_source}; never opened or followed
attributes.lnk_machine_id: NetBIOS machine name of the TrackerDataBlock of an LNK (the machine that created the shortcut): clustering identifier only, never sent to any lookup (P367 c7)
attributes.lnk_droid_mac: MAC address embedded in the version-1 droid file id of an LNK (the creating machine's network card): clustering identifier only, never sent to any lookup (P367 c7)
attributes.lnk_birth_droid_mac: MAC address of the birth droid file id of an LNK when it differs from the current droid: clustering identifier only, never looked up
attributes.lnk_volume_serial: volume serial number (XXXX-XXXX) of the drive that held the shortcut target: clustering identifier only, never looked up
attributes.lnk_decoded_command: statically decoded text of an LNK command line (e.g. PowerShell -EncodedCommand): evidence for the analyst, never run
attributes.msi_package: Windows Installer package facts: {product (ProductName, Manufacturer, ProductVersion, ProductCode, UpgradeCode, ProductLanguage), summary (SummaryInformation), signed, clsid, parser, tables_parser, table_names, stream_count, storages, property_count, cfb_anomalies}
attributes.msi_tables_status: whether the MSI CustomAction/Binary/Property tables were read: 'parsed', or 'MSI tables not parsed (<why>)' when the optional pymsi is missing or fails (never empty)
attributes.msi_custom_actions: MSI CustomAction rows decoded: {name, type, base, action, source_kind, description, source, target, command_line, deferred, no_impersonate, elevated, scheduled, payload_sha256, lolbin}; never executed
attributes.onenote_file: OneNote file facts: {header (file type, file GUID, format GUID check, expected length), embedded_count, embedded_names (heuristic EmbeddedFileName strings), kinds, parser}
attributes.embedded_files: files embedded in an artefact (LNK appended data, OneNote FileDataStoreObjects, MSI streams): {origin, name, kind, size, md5, sha1, sha256}; hashed in memory, never written to disk or executed
attributes.script_decoder_inputs: scripts and command lines handed to the P366 script decoder: {origin, kind, chars, sha256, decoder (script_decoder|stand-in), layers, iocs}; decoding is static, nothing is run

relations.lnk_target: shortcut -> URL/host/IP of its target when that target is a UNC/WebDAV share or URL (T1204.002): hostile, passive modules only, never resolved or contacted over HTTP, SMB or WebDAV
relations.lnk_icon: shortcut -> host/IP/URL of a remote icon location (fetched by Explorer on folder view: NTLM leak, T1187): hostile, passive modules only, never contacted
relations.lnk_reference: shortcut -> URL/host/IP found in its arguments, working directory or description: hostile, passive modules only, never contacted
relations.msi_reference: Windows Installer package -> URL/host/IP found in a CustomAction target or command line or in a Property value (ARP* properties are vendor metadata): passive modules only, never contacted
relations.lnk_metadata: shortcut -> clustering identifier (lnk_machine_id:, lnk_droid_mac:, lnk_volume_serial: keyword) that links artefacts of one campaign; expand=False, never sent to any lookup
